items.creator: Helena Woods
items.title: You have to go through the cringe
items.summary:
You have to go through the cringe. You have to look messy. 

You have to keep posting even when no one is watching you.

That’s been my journey. 

As a Taurus decan III sun (7 of pentacles life!) — the reward comes through years of showing up. And then waiting to see all that work pay off. I know this journey well.

〰️ My first YouTube channel I posted nearly 50 videos and didn’t get 100 subscribers until year 3. 

〰️ I also posted daily Instagram vlogs to my Instagram stories for years when I had 1,000 followers 

〰️ I published 1,000 Instagram posts before I hit 5,000 followers. 

〰️ I started blogging consistently when I started my first business in 2016. And I blogged to NO ONE until 2020. 
(Imagine writing to an empty void for years, knowing your stats, knowing that no one was reading what you had to say.)

Imagine still believing that it would all work out in the end. 

To this day, people think I’ve had easy success and it disgusts me. my biggest trigger 🤮 makes me vomit. 

Because everything I’ve done, worked for, consistently shown up to, I’ve been *training* for this moment. 

I enrolled in $500 online business courses when I was serving tables, could barely afford rent. 

I bought a one-way ticket to NYC at 18 years old with $2,000 because I deeply believed if anyone could make it there, it was me. 

I showed up constantly on the internet, believing that someday, people would wonder how I built my life — they’d dig up the archives and want to read what 23 year old me had to say. 

Maybe it’s delusion. 

Maybe it’s overconfidence. 

But that’s how I built this life. I believe in myself more than anyone else. No one is a bigger fan of my potential and capability than I am 

That’s what you need to lock in, if you have a crazy big dream. 

If you want a 7 figure online business. A life of freedom, fulfillment, passion and purpose. 

This is the power of BELIEF.

It’s believing in something invisible that’s not physical yet. It’s not having proof or evidence but knowing anyway. 

Your success is inevitable. 

Your dream life is the only available option. 

There is no alternative for you. 

Comment BEST DAY! ⤵️🎁🎧
